title: Yanshi Undermine
subtitle: Lower and Upper Undermine, Repugnant Eaters and the Yanshi Swarm Matron
steps: Take the Yanshi Lower Undermine portal from the Granite Quarry, then keep right. Kill Repugnant Eaters as you go; you need 50.
At the end of the lower mine, take the portal to the Upper Undermine.
Keep left and climb to the top. Kill the Yanshi Swarm Matron and loot her claw.
Give the claw to Royal Guard Adrana in Yanshi.

notes.title: 50 Eaters needs a respawn
notes.body: 17 Repugnant Eaters spawn here, all on one 5 minute generator. Expect about three clears, or fill the gap on the Plains of Ruin or in the Viamontian Royal Prison.

notes.title: Eater damage types
notes.body: Repugnant Eaters (level 115) take 120% slash and pierce, 60% bludgeon and acid. Six Abhorrent Eaters mixed in do not count.

notes.title: Swarm Matron
notes.body: Level 135. She takes 80% pierce, bludgeon and cold, 60% slash and fire, 55% lightning, and only 40% acid.

notes.title: Doors
notes.body: The five doors in the upper mine are not locked.
